title: PixPoint: correlation functions of HEALPix maps on GPUs and CPUs
description: PixPoint measures two-point, three-point, integrated three-point and one-point statistics of cosmological fields on HEALPix maps (cosmic shear, galaxy clustering, galaxy-galaxy lensing, convergence). The pixel pairs of a footprint are found once and reused for every map; measurements run on CPUs via Numba and on NVIDIA GPUs via CuPy. Documentation: https://pixpoint.readthedocs.io
